title: Trainee Quantity Surveyor
description:
**Role Summary**

The Quantity Surveyor (QS) will be responsible for managing all costs related to building and construction projects, from initial estimates through to final accounts. The role involves ensuring projects are completed within budget while maintaining high quality and design intent.

**Key Responsibilities Cost Planning & Estimation**

* Prepare detailed cost estimates based on architectural drawings and specifications
* Conduct feasibility studies and cost planning for new projects
* Advise architects and clients on cost-effective design solutions

**Tendering & Procurement**

* Prepare tender documents, BOQs (Bills of Quantities), and bid analysis reports
* Evaluate contractor bids and assist in contractor selection
* Manage procurement processes and vendor negotiations

**Project Cost Control**

* Monitor project budgets and track expenditures throughout the project lifecycle
* Identify cost variations and recommend corrective actions
* Prepare periodic financial reports and cash flow forecasts

**Contract Administration**

* Draft and review contracts and agreements
* Manage variations, claims, and final accounts
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations

**Site Coordination**

* Visit project sites to verify progress and valuations
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, and contractors
* Ensure work aligns with approved budgets and specifications

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related field
* 2–5+ years of experience in construction or architectural firms
* Strong knowledge of BOQs, estimation, and contract management
* Familiarity with construction materials and methods

**Skills & Competencies**

* Proficiency in estimation software and tools (e.g., Excel, AutoCAD)
* Strong analytical and numerical skills
* Excellent negotiation and communication abilities
* Attention to detail and problem-solving mindset
* Ability to work collaboratively in a design-focused environment

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Experience:

* QS: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: NAVAL ARCHITECT
company: S and O Maritime services private limited
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Naval Architect to join our Naval Architecture team at S&O Maritime Services Pvt. is seeking a skilled Naval Architect to support Naval Architecture projects, including basic and production design, engineering calculations, and project coordination. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, project management skills, and the ability to coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver quality engineering solutions within project timelines.

**POSITION**

Naval Architect

**COMPANY**

S&O Maritime Services Pvt. Ltd.

**LOCATION**

Aluva, Kerala

**EMPLOYMENT TYPE**

Full-Time | Permanent

(Preference will be given to candidates who are flexible and willing to undertake on-site deployments at shipyards, client locations, and marine or offshore project sites as required).

**EXPERIENCE**

2 - 4 Years of Relevant Experience

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*A. Project Management, Basic Design and Production Design*

* **Basic Design Coordination**: Coordinate and manage basic design activities, including preparation and review of general arrangement (GA) drawings, preliminary vessel layouts, design specifications, and other relevant naval architecture deliverables in accordance with project requirements.
* **Production Design Coordination**: Coordinate production design activities, including detailed engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, structural details, and production documentation, ensuring alignment with approved basic designs and shipyard requirements.
* **Project Planning and Progress Monitoring**: Plan and monitor engineering activities, track project schedules and deliverables, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and ensure timely completion of assigned work packages while maintaining effective communication with project managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
* **Technical Review and Project Execution**: Review design deliverables for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project specifications. Identify technical issues, coordinate corrective actions, support material take-offs and engineering documentation, and contribute to quality control throughout project execution.

*B. Basic Design Calculations, Stability and Ship Structure Analysis*

* **Basic Design Calculations:** Perform preliminary naval architecture calculations, including hydrostatics, displacement, weight estimation, centre of gravity, trim, draft, and other relevant calculations required to support vessel design and development.
* **Vessel Stability Analysis**: Perform preliminary intact stability calculations and assessments, evaluate relevant stability parameters, and support verification against applicable design criteria, classification requirements, and project specifications.
* **Ship Structure Analysis**: Assist in ship structural analysis and strength assessments, including evaluation of structural arrangements, loads, scantlings, and structural integrity in coordination with structural engineers and in accordance with applicable design requirements.
* **Engineering Calculations and Technical Documentation**: Prepare, review, and maintain calculation sheets, analysis reports, design assumptions, and supporting technical documentation. Coordinate with design and structural teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure consistency between engineering calculations, drawings, and project requirements.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Naval Architecture.

**Experience**

* 2 - 4 years of relevant experience in naval architecture, ship design, shipbuilding, marine engineering, vessel conversion, or offshore engineering.
* Experience in coordinating engineering activities, managing project deliverables, and working with multidisciplinary technical teams is preferred.

**Skills**

*Technical and Professional Skills*

* **Naval Architecture Fundamentals**: Good understanding of vessel design principles, hydrostatics, displacement, weight estimation, centre of gravity, trim, draft, and basic vessel stability calculations.
* **Design, Analysis and Engineering Software**: Candidates are expected to demonstrate proficiency in relevant software tools from the following list, depending on their area of expertise and project requirements:
* Autodesk AutoCAD
* Autodesk Inventor
* SOLIDWORKS
* Rhinoceros (Rhino 3D)
* AVEVA
* ShipConstructor
* CADMATIC
* Tekla Structures
* MOSES
* AutoShip
* AutoHydro
* AutoPower
* OpenFOAM
* SESAM
* ANSYS
* Bentley STAAD.Pro
* PV Elite
* **Engineering Drawings and Documentation**: Ability to prepare, interpret, and review general arrangement (GA) drawings, lines plans, vessel layouts, hull forms, technical specifications, and engineering calculation reports.
* **Marine Engineering and Construction:** Basic understanding of hull structures, ship construction methods, marine materials, welding, fabrication processes, and interfaces between naval architecture and structural engineering.
* **Classification and Regulatory Requirements**: Familiarity with classification society rules, including DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, and Bureau Veritas, as well as applicable IMO regulations and client-specific requirements.
* **Project Planning and Coordination:** Ability to organize engineering activities, track project schedules, monitor deliverables, coordinate resources, and manage multiple assignments within agreed timelines.
* **Technical Problem-Solving and Quality**: Ability to identify engineering discrepancies, assess technical challenges, review design outputs, and recommend practical, safe, and cost-effective solutions.

· **Professional Skills**: Effective communication, teamwork, task ownership, technical documentation, and proficiency in MS Office and project tracking tools.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Opportunity to work on marine and offshore engineering projects.
* Exposure to vessel design, shipbuilding, marine systems, and engineering project execution.
* Opportunities to develop technical expertise, project management capabilities, and leadership skills.
* Opportunity to work with experienced engineers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance, technical expertise, and leadership capabilities.
* Competitive salary in accordance with industry standards, qualifications, experience, and technical expertise.

**TO APPLY**

Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/Resume with the subject:

**“Application – Naval Architect”** Email: admin@sandomaritime.com

**WORK TYPE**

* Work Type: In-Person
* Employment: Full-Time | Permanent (Preference will be given to candidates willing to undertake on-site deployments at shipyards, client locations, and marine/offshore project sites).
* Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

**PAY**

Salary will be offered in accordance with industry standards and based on qualifications, relevant experience, technical expertise, and project management capabilities.

**WORK LOCATION**

S&O Maritime Services Pvt. Ltd.  
Aluva, Kerala, India

Pay: From ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Project Engineer (Civil)
description:
We are looking for a skilled and result-oriented Civil Project Engineer to oversee day-to-day construction activities, ensure quality workmanship, monitor project progress, and coordinate with contractors, consultants, and internal teams to ensure timely and cost-effective project execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Site Execution and Supervision**

* Supervise daily construction activities as per approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
* Monitor structural works, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, finishing works, and other civil activities.
* Ensure proper utilization of manpower, materials, machinery, and equipment.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and site workers to ensure smooth execution.

**B. Planning and Progress Monitoring**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly work progress reports.
* Monitor project schedules and ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
* Identify delays and take corrective measures in coordination with the Project Manager.
* Plan manpower and material requirements in advance.

**C. Quality Control**

* Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Conduct site inspections and coordinate required material and workmanship tests.
* Identify and rectify defects and non-conformities.
* Ensure proper implementation of quality control procedures.

**D. Cost and Material Management**

* Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.
* Verify material requirements and coordinate procurement with the purchase team.
* Check measurements of completed work and verify contractor bills.
* Assist in quantity estimation, rate analysis, and cost control.

**E. Drawing and Documentation**

* Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings before execution.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, and MEP teams to resolve site-related issues.
* Maintain daily site reports, measurement records, inspection reports, and other project documentation.
* Ensure the latest approved drawings are available at the site.

**F. Safety and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with site safety procedures and applicable construction regulations.
* Monitor the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Maintain proper housekeeping and safe working conditions at the site.
* Report unsafe practices and take corrective action.

**G. Team and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Project Manager, architects, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and other departments.
* Attend site meetings and provide updates on project progress and issues.
* Resolve site execution issues promptly and escalate major concerns when necessary.
* Support the team in achieving project milestones and handover targets.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* **Education:** B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
* **Experience:** 10 years of relevant experience in building construction, especially high rise apartments.
* Knowledge of structural and finishing works, construction methods, and quality control procedures.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
* Familiarity with quantity estimation, measurements, and contractor bill verification.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD and MS Excel; familiarity with project planning software is an advantage.

The Project Engineer is expected to ensure that all assigned construction activities are executed safely, within the approved budget and schedule, and in accordance with the company's quality standards and project specifications.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Construction: 10 years (Required)

description:
ARCHITECTURAL CONTENT DESIGNER / SOCIAL MEDIA CREATIVE

Company: National Design Groups (NADG)

Industry: Architecture **Interiors**  Landscape

Location: Kerala

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Probation Salary: ₹18,000/month for the first 2 months

Salary after Probation: Revised based on performance, creative ability and responsibility

ABOUT THE ROLE

National Design Groups (NADG) is looking for a creative Architect or Interior Designer with a strong interest in architectural content, graphic design and social media.

This is not a conventional social media executive position.

We are looking for someone who understands architecture and design well enough to translate our projects, concepts, drawings, materials, site progress and design thinking into high\-quality visual content for NADG's digital platforms.

The person should be capable of understanding the design language of NADG and maintaining a consistent, sophisticated and architecture\-focused visual identity across our social media.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage and develop creative content for NADG's architecture and design social media pages.

Create visually strong Instagram posts, carousels, stories and reel concepts.

Convert architectural projects into meaningful visual stories rather than simply posting project photographs.

Work with architects and designers to understand the concept and design thinking behind each project.

Develop content using:

Architectural renders

Plans and drawings

Concept sketches

Material palettes

Site photographs

Detail drawings

Before/after development

Design\-process documentation

Develop conceptual and editorial\-style architectural posts.

Maintain consistency in typography, layouts, graphics, colours and overall visual language.

Prepare a monthly/weekly content calendar and ensure consistent publishing.

Coordinate with the NADG design team to collect drawings, photographs, renders and project information.

Identify interesting architectural details and stories within ongoing projects that can become content.

Research high\-quality architecture and design studios globally to understand evolving presentation and communication trends.

Help establish a distinctive NADG content language instead of following generic social\-media trends.

Coordinate with photographers, videographers or the existing media team whenever required.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Preferred Qualification:

B.Arch / B.Des / Interior Design / Architecture\-related qualification.

Fresh graduates with exceptional creative ability may apply. Candidates with professional architecture/interior\-design experience are also welcome.

REQUIRED SKILLS

Strong understanding of architecture, interiors, materials and design presentation.

Excellent visual sense and composition.

Good understanding of typography and minimal graphic design.

Ability to understand architectural drawings and renders.

Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator / InDesign or equivalent design software.

Canva or similar content\-design tools.

Basic understanding of Instagram content formats and social\-media communication.

Ability to write or develop short, intelligent architectural captions with the team.

Strong attention to detail.

Knowledge of SketchUp, AutoCAD, rendering software, video editing, Procreate or AI creative tools will be an advantage.

THE PERSON WE WANT

We are looking for someone who can look at an architectural project and ask:

“What is the idea behind this design, and how can we communicate it beautifully?”

We do not want our page to become a collection of random renders, trending reels or repetitive promotional posts.

The objective is to build an architectural page that reflects design thinking, originality, materiality, detailing, process and the character of NADG.

The candidate should therefore have:

Strong creative curiosity

An eye for good architecture

Independent thinking

Willingness to research and experiment

Ability to accept design criticism and improve

Consistency and discipline in content production

PROBATION \& COMPENSATION

First 2 months: ₹18,000/month probation salary.

During the probation period, performance will be evaluated based on:

Quality of creative output

Understanding of NADG's design language

Originality of content ideas

Visual consistency

Content planning and execution

Ability to understand architectural projects

Speed and reliability

Initiative and independent thinking

After successful completion of the probation period, salary will be revised based on demonstrated performance and the level of responsibility the candidate can independently handle.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENT

Applicants should submit:

1\. CV / Resume

2\. Architecture / Interior Design Portfolio

3\. Graphic design or social\-media work, if available

Along with the portfolio, applicants may also share 2–3 architecture or design Instagram pages they admire and briefly explain what they like about their content.

Important

Portfolio quality and creative thinking will be given more importance than years of experience.

We are not looking for someone simply to “manage Instagram.”

We are looking for a designer who can help build the visual voice of NADG.
